annotations.text:
The app is a dictionary, so it reads like one.
Serif headwords, small-caps labels, hairline rules,
the prompt word given room to dominate.

Instrument Serif + Public Sans, warm paper, the
existing green kept as the accent.

The typed question and its three results. One rule under the answer, in the result colour - the correct form appears only when it
differs from what you typed, so a right answer is not repeated back at you. Green / amber / brick are the tokens already in the app.

No counts anywhere on the home screen. The two lower rows
are narrowings of Practise, not rival choices, and each only
appears when it holds something. Totals live in Settings.

Phase 2 formats. Multiple choice draws distractors from the same part of speech
and tag; the flashcard back doubles as a mini dictionary entry.
